ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Managing waste environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Light environment School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
